'''''Combat Techniques of a Jedi Battlemaster''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]], who held the position of [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] and was the second teacher of [[Satele Shan]]. Shan, who later became the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], brought a copy of ''Studies of the Force'' with her on her self-imposed exile to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odessen]].
